# coolify_application_restart

Restart a Coolify application. Creating this resource sends a restart signal to the specified application. Deleting this resource is a no-op — it does not affect the application.

## Exemplo de Uso

```terraform
resource "coolify_application_restart" "restart_my_app" {
  application_uuid = coolify_application_dockerimage.api.id
}
```

## Argumentos e Atributos

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_uuid` (String) UUID of the application to restart.

### Read-Only

- `deployment_uuid` (String) UUID of the deployment triggered by the restart action.
- `message` (String) Status message returned by the Coolify API after the restart action.

## Importação

```shell
terraform import coolify_application_restart.example <application-uuid>
```
